title: Supply of Battery Charger for various Lighthouse under Chennai Directorate
summary: Open two-cover e-tender on CPPP for supply of battery chargers for various lighthouses under the Chennai Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

scope.item: Supply of Battery Charger for various Lighthouse under Chennai Directorate

money.notes: Tender value shown in public domain. EMD fixed, exemption not allowed, payable to Director of Lighthouses and Lightships at Chennai by DD/FDR (offline). Product category: Batteries and cells and accessories / Battery Charger. GeMARPTS non-availability reason: urgent nature of procurement, one time purchase. PPP-MII and MSE orders marked not applicable.

eligibility: Reputed Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) or authorized dealers of OEMs, licensed contractors, parties or Government Undertakings
notes: File is only the CPPP 'Tender Details' printout. The actual tender document (BatteryChargerTender.pdf), BOQ (BOQ_895142.xls) and Tendernotice_1.pdf are referenced but not included, so quantities, charger specifications and stations are not available. Bid openers' personal details omitted.
